messages:
toni: hey everyone, day 1 and stuck on Console perms. I can view staging but prod admin panel gives 403 when I try to open feature flags.
ben: welcome Toni! For prod admin views you need `console:prod-admin-read`. Did you go through the access request flow?
toni: I clicked Request Access from the UI but it failed with an error. Screenshot attached to the ticket. Is there a manual path?
samira: samira from infra here  we can manually attach the role if you DM your employee id and list the projects. Quick note: the UI request sometimes times out if your SSO session is stale.
toni: id 11234. projects: billing, payments. I only need readonly on flags and the ability to see audit logs.
samira: send this payload in the infra ticket: `name: Toni L; id: 11234; env: prod; projects: billing,payments; scopes: console:prod-admin-read,audit:logs-read; reason: onboarding smoke tests`. We'll triage fast.
toni: thanks. Also saw a prompt about "approval workflow". Who usually approves flag reads in prod?
ben: owners approve toggles; read scopes are infra-only. For toggles you need owners + security signoff for sensitive flags. If you need a one-off flip we can arrange eng-sre to run it with you.
toni: is there a standard runbook for safe flips I can review?
samira: yes  check the internal doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/safe-flag-flips. If you want, I can walk you through the canary steps after access is granted.
infra-bot: [automated] Ticket INFR-5012 created by toni. Status: awaiting infra action. Link: https://redwood.internal/infr/INFR-5012
toni: perfect, I opened the ticket and linked the screenshots. tagging @ben and @samira in case anything else is needed. Appreciate the speedy help!
